metadata.description: Plugins that make Claude Code's work checkable: engineering guidance for how the work is done, and an evidence-local knowledge compiler for what it is done from.

plugins.name: engineering-doctrine
plugins.description: Guides Claude Code to trace root causes, establish ownership and invariants, change only what the task requires, verify behavior with evidence, preserve existing work and user data, and review the result before claiming completion.

plugins.name: eck
plugins.description: Compiles a project's notes, decisions and code into knowledge you can be held to: every answer carries what it rests on, an unreviewed claim is never reported as an agreed one, and nothing is written without someone seeing exactly what it would write. The runtime is bundled; nothing else is installed.
